archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Premium Enterprise SaaS Dark Mode
design_philosophy: A category-defining Leadership Operating System. Inspired by Linear, Stripe, Attio, Vercel, Arc. The design must feel clean, elegant, premium, spacious, and trustworthy. Use high-contrast typography, deep dark backgrounds, subtle glowing accents, and crisp 1px borders. Avoid heavy generic gradients, cheap illustrations, and cartoon icons. Rely heavily on CSS styling, typography, and code-based UI mockups (Shadcn/Recharts) to establish the 'Executive' and 'Enterprise' feel.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-semibold text-white

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers. Deep breathability.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: For feature sections, use a bento box layout with asymmetric spans (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2 mixed with col-span-1 row-span-1).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: For dashboard mockups, use a tight Control Room grid (gap-4 or gap-6) where every pixel is utilized.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background (#131A24), 1px subtle border (border-white/5 or border-white/10). On hover, translate-y-1, increase border opacity to border-white/20, and add a subtle primary glow shadow.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky nav or floating elements: bg-[#0B0F17]/70, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px top/bottom border of white/10.

components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#6D5EF5] text-white hover:bg-[#594CE0] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all. Secondary CTA: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium.
components_strategy.badges: Small, rounded-full, border border-[#6D5EF5]/30 bg-[#6D5EF5]/10 text-[#9F8BFF] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium tracking-wide.
components_strategy.dashboard_mockups: CRITICAL: Do not use static images for dashboards. Build the dashboard visuals using Shadcn UI components (Cards, Tables, Badges) and Recharts. This creates an ultra-crisp, premium Vercel-like tech feel.

images.description: Synqora official logo. Use in Navbar and Footer.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. For Trust Bar, use a combination of Lucide geometric icons (Triangle, Hexagon, Command) paired with text to simulate partner logos.

motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion. Elements should fade in and slide up slightly (y: 20 to y: 0) as they enter the viewport.
motion_and_interaction.diagram_animation: For the 'Solution' flow diagram, use CSS or framer-motion to create glowing dots or dashed lines that travel between nodes (Sales -> Delivery -> Execution -> Insights -> Leadership).

page_sections.description: Centered large heading. Subheadline. Primary and Secondary CTAs. Below the text, a massive, code-built Dashboard Mockup contained in a browser-like window, angled or straight, with floating metric cards (Revenue, Business Health, Project Health) overlapping the edges for depth. Add a radial CSS glow behind the dashboard.
Muted, grayscale logos of enterprise clients (use Lucide icons + text). 'Designed for Research Firms, Consulting Companies, Knowledge Services'.
Grid of 4 premium cards. Heading: 'Growing Businesses Don't Lack Data. They Lack Visibility.' Cards should use the 'Tracing Beam' or subtle border hover effect.
Animated flow diagram built with CSS/Framer Motion. Nodes representing 'Sales', 'Delivery', 'Execution', 'Insights' flowing into a central glowing 'Leadership Decisions' hub.

Interactive layout. Left side: Vertical list of modules (Leadership Command Center, Sales Performance, etc.). Right side: A code-built dashboard preview that changes based on the active module on the left.
Outcome-based benefits. 3-column grid. Clean, minimal typography with large glowing abstract icons or numbers.
4-step vertical timeline (Connect, Capture, Analyze, Lead). As user scrolls, a line connecting the steps lights up.

Large interactive section. A tabbed interface (CEO, COO, Business Head, Sales, Operations). Clicking a tab swaps out the Recharts and Shadcn metrics displayed in the massive dashboard container below it.
Premium Bento layout. 9 items. Use asymmetric spans. Each card should have a subtle dark background (#131A24) and soft border.
Testimonial cards. Clean quotes, avatar placeholders (colored circles with initials), and 5-star Lucide icons.
Shadcn Accordion component for questions like 'Can Synqora replace CRM?'
Large contained block with a strong radial gradient glow. Big heading, 'Ready to Lead with Complete Visibility?', and a 'Book Your Demo' button.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, accordions) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'hero-book-demo-button', 'role-tab-ceo').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least AA contrast ratio against #0B0F17 and #131A24 backgrounds.
